description: This file defines the ContextCleaner class responsible for asynchronous cleanup of RDDs, shuffles, broadcasts, accumulators, checkpoints, and SparkListeners in Apache Spark. It manages weak references to these objects and performs cleanup when they are no longer in scope, including thread management and listener notifications.

classes.name: CleanupTask
classes.description: Sealed trait representing different cleanup tasks for RDDs, shuffles, broadcasts, accumulators, checkpoints, and SparkListeners.

classes.name: CleanRDD
classes.description: Cleanup task for RDDs identified by rddId.

classes.name: CleanShuffle
classes.description: Cleanup task for shuffles identified by shuffleId.

classes.name: CleanBroadcast
classes.description: Cleanup task for broadcasts identified by broadcastId.

classes.name: CleanAccum
classes.description: Cleanup task for accumulators identified by accId.

classes.name: CleanCheckpoint
classes.description: Cleanup task for RDD checkpoint data identified by rddId.

classes.name: CleanupTaskWeakReference
classes.description: WeakReference subclass associated with a CleanupTask, used for garbage collection tracking.

classes.name: ContextCleaner
classes.description: Main class managing asynchronous cleanup of Spark objects, with thread management, reference tracking, and listener notification.

classes.name: CleanerListener
classes.description: Trait defining callback methods for cleanup events of RDDs, shuffles, broadcasts, accumulators, checkpoints, and SparkListeners.

methods.name: attachListener
methods.description: Attach a CleanerListener to receive cleanup event notifications.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Start the cleanup thread and scheduled garbage collection.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stop the cleanup thread and scheduled tasks gracefully.

methods.name: registerRDDForCleanup
methods.description: Register an RDD for cleanup upon garbage collection.

methods.name: registerAccumulatorForCleanup
methods.description: Register an accumulator for cleanup upon garbage collection.

methods.name: registerShuffleForCleanup
methods.description: Register a shuffle dependency for cleanup upon garbage collection.

methods.name: registerBroadcastForCleanup
methods.description: Register a broadcast variable for cleanup upon garbage collection.

methods.name: registerRDDCheckpointDataForCleanup
methods.description: Register RDD checkpoint data for cleanup upon garbage collection.

methods.name: registerSparkListenerForCleanup
methods.description: Register a SparkListener for cleanup upon garbage collection.

methods.name: keepCleaning
methods.description: Internal method running in a loop to process cleanup tasks from the reference queue.

methods.name: doCleanupRDD
methods.description: Perform cleanup of an RDD given its ID.

methods.name: doCleanupShuffle
methods.description: Perform cleanup of a shuffle given its ID.

methods.name: doCleanupBroadcast
methods.description: Perform cleanup of a broadcast variable given its ID.

methods.name: doCleanupAccum
methods.description: Perform cleanup of an accumulator given its ID.

methods.name: doCleanCheckpoint
methods.description: Clean checkpoint data for a given RDD ID.

methods.name: doCleanSparkListener
methods.description: Remove a SparkListener from the SparkContext.
